scripts.test: npm run test:bulletin && npm run test:scraper
scripts.lint: npm run lint:bulletin && npm run lint:scraper
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:bulletin:fix && npm run lint:scraper:fix
scripts.lint:scraper: cd wev-scraper && if [ -x venv/bin/ruff ]; then venv/bin/ruff check .; elif [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check .; else ruff check .; fi
scripts.lint:scraper:fix: cd wev-scraper && if [ -x venv/bin/ruff ]; then venv/bin/ruff check . --fix; elif [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check . --fix; else ruff check . --fix; fi
scripts.typecheck:scraper: cd wev-scraper && if [ -x venv/bin/pyright ]; then venv/bin/pyright; elif [ -x .venv/bin/pyright ]; then .venv/bin/pyright; else pyright; fi
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run lint:scraper && npm run typecheck:scraper && npm run tsc && npm run test
scripts.verify:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run lint:scraper:fix && npm run typecheck:scraper && npm run tsc && npm run test
scripts.sync:local: npm run backup && npm run restore:test
scripts.sync:staging: npm run backup && npm run restore:staging
